g.text: HGT-based Actor-Critic Scheduler for JSSP Intersection Control
Academic architectural pipeline for graph reinforcement learning in Job Shop Scheduling Problem
Nodes represent active agents and resources
Map raw node features to joint space
Relation-dependent transforms for target v, source u:
Softmax attention weight for edge (u, v) of relation r:
α(u, v, r) = softmaxu(score(u, v, r))
Message aggregation is summed across all 5
Learns dispatch preference from priority scores
Enforces legality to prevent deadlock & collision
Calculates exact start and finish schedule times
